components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Charcoal action button for the primary task on a screen.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 43px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; color: #ffffff; background: #3a3937; font: 600 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #272624; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71645a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared field for readable form entry and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #3a3937; font: 400 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 43px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #d7d1cd; border-radius: 8px; color: #3a3937; background: #ffffff; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3a3937; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Public Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet public-site link with a clear hover and focus state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; color: #3a3937; font: 500 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71645a; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status label that keeps operational meaning distinct.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-badge-success { color: #26735b; background: #e7f3ed; }

components.name: Public Catalog Row
components.description: Open public catalog card treatment in the responsive three/two/one column grid.
components.css: .ds-catalog-row { padding: 24px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7d1cd; border-radius: 0; color: #3a3937; background: transparent; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-row h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 24px 'Playfair Display', serif; } .ds-catalog-row p { color: #514d49; }

narrative.overview: The approved identity uses the actual supplied AMAC logo with a charcoal, off-white, and taupe palette. Public pages use spacious serif-led composition and a open catalog card presentation in a responsive three/two/one column grid. The same brand theme carries through login and administrator, customer, and staff workspaces, where information density follows the task. Shared controls and theme values are owned by packages/ui and packages/theme; app-specific public composition lives in apps/web/src/styles/public/site.css.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, spacious public presentation with serif display headings.
Sans-serif text and controls for reading and operational tasks.
Charcoal, paper, and taupe identity with distinct readable taupe text.
Operational status colors and information density remain clear in workspaces.

rules.name: The Readable Taupe Rule
rules.body: Use the darker readable taupe for text and focus indicators; reserve the lighter taupe for decoration.

rules.name: The Status Clarity Rule
rules.body: Keep success, warning, danger, and information colors distinct in operational workflows.

dos: Use the shared theme tokens and UI components for new branded surfaces.
Preserve the operational status palette and clarity of dense workspace tasks.
donts: Do not redraw, recolor, or distort the supplied logo.
Do not apply public-page density to information-heavy workspace workflows.
Do not treat visual choices as changes to product policy or scope.
